text: Carpentry is a discipline that requires precise techniques to shape and assemble wooden structures. The process begins with sawing the wood, which serves as the foundation of the project. A good saw, such as a circular saw, is essential for creating clean cuts and precise measurements. Following the sawing process, the wood must be planed and sanded to create a smooth surface and enhance the visual appeal of the project. This is a crucial step, as a smooth surface can greatly improve the overall look and feel of the finished product. Lastly, carpenters will use a variety of sanding techniques to smooth the surface and ensure a high-quality finish. This paragraph aims to provide a basic understanding of the carpentry process and its key stages.
